{{Top|leg}}
'''Armorply plating''', simply known as '''Armorply''' was a type of [[armor]].<ref name="Cloak">''[[Cloak of Deception]]''</ref><ref name="KOTOR2">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''</ref>

Armorply was an armored cloth that could be tailored thin or thick for different levels of protection, in garments ranging from full suits to protective vests.<ref name="Cloak" /> Offering protection against energy and physical attacks, armorply was worn when suppleness and flexibility was needed, and was considered a military grade material.<ref name="Cloak" />

==Behind the scenes==
In ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]'', this upgrade can be used on all types armor, except for robes.
